description: Returns one week of the UK Christmas dinner basket summary (weekly to 24 Dec 2026): posted shelf prices of numbered items at Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Aldi with flags, or totals over the items each retailer priced. Item numbers only, no product names. Not a CPI and not a price comparison: retailers in a fixed order, never by price; totals cover different items. Weekly snapshots, not live; the open week changes until Sunday. Omit week for the latest. Quote the notes with any total.

retailer.description: Only this retailer, e.g. "asda". Omit for all four.

view.description: "totals" (each retailer total over the items it priced, and the count) or "items" (the price and flags of each item). Omit for "totals".

week.description: ISO week, e.g. "2026-W45". Omit for the latest week held.

name: get_christmas_basket_prices
title: Christmas dinner basket, weekly summary
